rules.reads: Never advance football, consume live RNG, or stamp probability observations
rules.access: Authenticated active Chairman; server verifies session authorization before data access
rules.corrections: Open Edit temporarily blocks. Saved football correction blocks detail for the session/game, including acceptance and continuation. Audit absence/gap blocks. Cancellation restores only if no prior correction. Restart cannot erase correction evidence.
rules.unknown: Unknown event descriptions or missing required fields block derived totals rather than silently omit plays
rules.yardage: Credited offense excludes interception travel, punts, field goals, and kickoff resets; truncate TD gains and safety losses at goal line; use adjudicated spot for turnover outcomes
rules.accounting: College sacks and kneels count as rushing attempts and yards. Passing attempts exclude sacks. First downs include eligible touchdowns; turnover plays do not convert. Zero denominator yields null, rendered dash.
rules.time: TOP is recorded engine football-clock accounting. GL is distinct and continues until Final. Resolution clock is not snap time.
rules.overtime: Line score includes OT; snaps/yards/efficiency regulation only; no invented OT plays
rules.wp: Read-only separate versioned illustrative estimator; central five-second observations, never browser-generated; prior and model freeze at launch; BLOCKED grey after corrections; no gambling or known future inputs
rules.delivery: Revision-bound snapshot plus paginated immutable plays; reject stale mixed-run pages; reconnect from acknowledged sequence; idempotent journal identity includes session/game/run/model/event
rules.ui: Chairman only; text teams, #ECECEC page background; exact canonical palette and final layout remain subject to supplied design artifact

units.fieldPosition: yards from current offense own goal, 0..100
units.rawYards: engine generated yards, not necessarily credited offense
units.yardsPerOffensivePlay: yards/resolved offensive snap; null with zero snaps
